admission_prerequisites.needed: Named finite-mode projection of current UET lane or quantitatively bounded reduction to the selected native operator; a beam coordinate is not Phi by label
Both electrodes' DC/AC settings, equilibrium offsets and local linearization in the same material state; no pooling bias settings as one frozen kernel
Calibrated electrode-to-modal generalized forces, voltage phase/time and gap dependence; retain or bound direct harmonic forcing
Signed complex two-axis records, timing/exposure and detector transfer; point A to generalized-coordinate mapping at point B and independent relative gain
Readable verified S16/S18 normalization plus independently supported modal masses/profiles and covariance or conservative bounds; do not set alpha1=2*alpha2 in published dimensionless coordinates
Joint uncertainties for geometry/frequency calibration, source/readout/noise, damping and omitted terms in the actual comparison output; no universal 10 percent bound inferred
Exact eligible two-channel row/trajectory locator and usage terms, provenance, calibration partition and previous-exposure record; published curves already inspected are not blind holdout
